column3: Keep Avalon and the wet artist concept. Lower Gate THRE 28→10; COMP4 Sustain 65→45; B-Chorus VOL 100→50 as an initial level-matching trial. Reduce EQ 33Hz +6→0, 600Hz -8→-2 and 8kHz +10→+3. Keep Narcissus as the baseline chorus, but reduce its Depth 55→30 before stacking B-Chorus Depth 70. Hall Mix 25→15. This retains the vocal fretless effect while giving the fundamental and decay room. Correct the artist history: Offramp belongs to the later Metheny lineup; verify credits before retaining the Egan attribution.

Keep the Avalon/Tidal Wave architecture and no CTL. Try COMP4 Sustain 55→35 for the MIDI slap option because the Donner is already at COMP 55. Keep the sub-octave optional and test it above the bass's lowest register. Rename the title around Clay Gober/Polyphia rather than Tim Henson; the write-up already identifies the bassist correctly.

B-Chorus Rate 2.5→0.6Hz, Depth 40→25; Air Mix 35→12 and Decay 45→30. The current atmospheric state is much more animated and wet than the stated supporting bass role. Keep the dry state. Correct the stale 4x10 description to the slot's 8x10 and verify the There She Goes release attribution. Remove the unsupported claim that the bassist never used overdrive.

Use one principal added drive. Remove PRE B-Boost; reduce Bass OD Gain 65→30 and Blend 60→35, then compare with Tidal Wave drive alone. EQ 33Hz +8→0, 2kHz +12→+4, 8kHz +15→+3; capture Treble 70→58. This is several serial treble/drive boosts masquerading as a parallel rig. Clarify that the Bass OD dry blend still passes through the driven capture, and that Tidal Wave drive-off leaves its preamp active. Preserve the intentionally inverted CTL.

Keep the dry CleanB15 foundation and shared board settings. Test Micro Boost Gain 32→20 for the last chorus; use only enough to increase harmonic presence, since this sits before the capture and cannot guarantee a clean output lift. Retain the current setting if the capture stays clean and levels match.
Micro Boost Gain 45→25; Room Mix 20→8. EQ 33Hz +3→0 and 8kHz +3→0. A retro rounded fretless pocket benefits more from attack consistency than extra subs and room. Keep the passive Sire and FullB15.

Bypass the always-on Analog delay first; lower B-Chorus Depth 35→18 and Room Mix 22→8. Micro Boost Gain 45→25. The production's haze does not establish a need for delayed bass notes; the rhythmic line should remain distinct.

Keep the atmospheric CTL concept. Start DLY Mix 30→18, Hall Mix 35→18, capture Bass 60→55 and EQ 50Hz +3→+1. Lower THRE 20→8 for fretless decay. Correct the assumption that active electronics automatically improve input headroom; set the Sire preamp near flat and check peaks.
Keep Avalon and the warm clean voice. Plate Mix 20→8, Decay 45→30; capture Bass 60→55. Let long notes sustain through compression and touch rather than a large reverberant low end.

Keep the GP-5 compressor substitution and CTL EQ lift. Room Mix 16→8; EQ CTL VOL 56→52 as a first level-match trial. The current EQ switch also boosts output and high mids, so verify it reads as a chorus lift rather than a second bass channel.

Micro Boost Gain 48→25; Room Mix 16→8. Keep the shared country foundation clean. Compare this version against the GP-5-only version at matched perceived level; their patch volumes and gain stages differ, so they are not interchangeable at present.
Room Mix 18→8; Micro Boost Gain 45→25. Keep CleanSVT and the supportive midrange. The chorus should become more assertive through playing, with only a small pedal contribution.

Remove the Bass OD chorus lift; move CTL to a mild output/EQ lift using Bass EQ 2 with the present curve and VOL 54 as a starting point. Keep the verse curve effectively unchanged by moving its small tonal offsets into the capture if needed. No documented need for added dirt in this warm folk-rock target.
Keep BrightSVT. Bass OD Gain 45→25, Blend 60→35; Room Mix 20→0/bypassed. EQ 4.5kHz +6→+3 and capture Bass 62→56. This should produce clearer fast eighths without losing pick bite.

Remove the always-on GP-5 Bass OD and use the board Tidal Wave as the main added drive; retain BrightSVT. Micro Boost Gain 50→25, Room Mix 18→0/bypassed. The current Tidal Wave + Bass OD + driven capture stack risks replacing the bass's attack with saturation. Update the stomp map with the revised drive source.

Keep the clean Avalon core and single board compressor. Make Flamma optional rather than continuously necessary: compare dry against the documented octave blend and favor dry if the lowest notes blur. Room Mix 6 is already restrained. No automatic amp change.

Remove CTL Bass OD; keep the Hall option at Mix 12→6 or use CTL for an EQ/output lift instead. Capture Bass 60→56. Preserve the gospel build through level and playing dynamics rather than introducing distortion by default.
Keep FullB15 and the dark main line. Test CTL Bass OD Gain 40→25, Blend 45→30; Room Mix 12→6. This keeps the heavy section focused on the recurring bass figure instead of extra wash.

Keep the shared board settings unchanged. Capture Bass 62→56 and EQ 50Hz +4→+1. Make the Flamma climax layer optional and register-limited; a low-B fundamental plus added octave can spend headroom without adding useful pitch definition.

Remove GP-5 COMP while retaining the shared Donner setting. Church Mix 20→6, Decay 60→30; EQ 50Hz +5→+1, 800Hz -3→0. A communion part needs audible note identity at low level, not a scooped sub-heavy reverberant floor. Keep patch VOL 48 pending a set-level listening check.

Remove CTL Bass OD; keep the EQ-only melodic lift. EQ 800Hz +5→+3, VOL 52 unchanged initially. Keep the low gate and restrained room. This gives clean fretless expression without a distortion block unrelated to the stated target.

Bass OD Gain 50→30, Blend 55→35; bypass CTL Room and reduce PRE Sustain 50→40 if note attacks flatten. Keep GrittySVT. The chorus needs solid low notes beneath the guitars more than another dense gain layer.

Replace CTL Bass OD with the existing Tidal Wave drive stomp: trial Drive 30, Blend 35 while keeping the preamp settings. Remove GP-5 Room or reduce Mix 10→5. Keep GrittySVT and the P/J pick voice. Write the extra stomp explicitly rather than pretending CTL can operate the board.

Keep Avalon. Room Mix 25→8; capture Treble 65→58 and EQ 4.5kHz +4→+2. The interlude may open up without putting a quarter-wet bass behind the guitar. Fix the Tidal Wave bypass language and document its continuously active preamp controls.

Remove the always-on Bass OD first; audition HairySVT alone for the main line. If more drive is needed, use Bass OD on CTL at Gain 25, Blend 30 instead of fixed Gain 65/Blend 75. Lower THRE 30→15, Room Mix 20→6. Keep the recognizable bass figure forward and avoid assuming fuzz because the guitars are grungy.

Remove CTL Bass OD; Hall Mix 22→6 and Decay 50→30. Capture Bass 62→56; EQ 33Hz +3→0. Keep CleanSVT and gentle compression. The bass should hold the harmonic floor while the guitar supplies the soaring effect.

Bass OD Gain 45→25, Blend 58→35; PRE Sustain 55→40 and Gate THRE 25→12. Keep ProgSVT provisionally. The write-up derives the sound from the band generally, so confirm this particular arrangement before committing to a heavy section map.

Bypass GP-5 COMP and A-Chorus first, keeping the Donner and CleanSVT. Room Mix 20→8. A dry, lightly controlled melodic bass is a better starting point than dual compression plus continuous chorus; retain modulation only if the actual part calls for it.

Keep BrightSVT and the clean/heavy split. Bass OD Gain 42→30, Blend 55→40; Hall Mix 15→6. Use Trail on if the transition is intended to preserve long held notes; Trail off is valid when a hard stop is required.

Boost Gain 65→25 and +3dB on→off; EQ 33Hz +6→0, 600Hz -6→-2, 2kHz +8→+3. Capture Middle 65→55. The current 'clean' patch includes substantial pre-capture boosting and multiple presence boosts. Replace the Narcissus '2 o'clock, slow' contradiction with an unambiguous low Rate position around 9 o'clock.

OCTA Low 45→20, Dry 80→100; Bass OD Gain 30→15 and Blend 30→20. Keep octave off for low-register passages where the generated sub adds little useful pitch. Explicitly frame this as an electric-bass adaptation of a synth part.

Keep the dry power-metal layout. Bass OD Gain 30→20, Blend 40→30 and COMP4 Sustain 55→40 as a clarity trial. Verify Gate THRE 25 against fast soft notes before lowering it. No amp substitution needed.

Micro Boost Gain 55→25; Room Mix 18→6. Capture Treble 62→55 and EQ 2kHz +5→+2. Keep Avalon. Rewrite the exact original DI/rig assertions as unverified unless supported by a session source; the modern Avalon capture is a tonal substitute.

Keep the clean, nearly dry soul architecture and one compressor. Try EQ 400Hz -1→+1 for more vocal low-mid identity instead of more bass. Retain the current curve if that crowds the arrangement. No forced CTL addition.
Bass OD Gain 28→15, Blend 30→20; Room Mix 12→0/bypassed. EQ 50Hz +3→+1. Keep FullB15 and compression. Deep hip-hop-influenced bass benefits from a stable clean fundamental rather than added ambience.

Recheck the actual song arrangement before retaining the generic prog-metal dirty state. Start by removing Bass OD and using CleanB15 slot 51, Gain 50/VOL 80/Bass 53/Middle 53/Treble 48, with the existing light EQ and Plate Mix 6. This is a provisional clean/woody alternative, not a claim about the recorded rig; compare against the recording before replacing ProgSVT.

Remove Green OD Gain 60 from the bass path; it has no clean Blend control. Use FullB15 alone first, or CTL Bass OD Gain 20/Blend 25/VOL 55 if a dirty layer is actually needed. Remove Micro Boost from the same CTL move and lower Hall Mix 25→6. Preserve the syncopated fundamental through the climax.

Remove always-on Bass OD Gain 65/Blend 75. Keep GrittySVT as the main drive voice; Micro Boost Gain 58→25 and Room Mix 22→0/bypassed. EQ 2kHz +6→+3. Tight fast bass needs definition before more saturation and room.
Remove the CTL Bass OD and Room combination; use a modest CTL EQ lift if a second state proves useful. PRE Sustain 55→40; EQ 33Hz +5→0 and 2kHz +5→+2. Keep the mid-forward CleanSVT funk core.

Keep WorshipSVT and the shared Tidal Wave stomp map. Test Micro Boost Gain 30→20 only when combined with the board drive; both stages add capture input level. Preserve the fixed set-wide board controls.

Keep the light chorus and ProgSVT provisionally. Bass OD Gain 25→15, Blend 38→20; Hall Mix 16→8. Consider removing dirt entirely if the particular bass part stays clean; avoid inferring its settings from the heavier Riverside songs.

Remove GP-5 COMP and continuous A-Chorus; keep the shared Donner and board foundation. EQ 33Hz +4→0 and Room Mix 12→6. A warm organic pocket needs low-mid note body and dynamics more than a generic chorus texture.

Remove GP-5 Bass OD and use one principal added drive: the Tidal Wave at trial Drive 25/Blend 35 into GrittySVT. Micro Boost Gain 55→25; Room Mix 20→0/bypassed. Keep the exposed riff articulate before increasing dirt.

Keep the Donner as the first compressor; COMP4 Sustain 70→35, Clip 15→40 as an input-sensitivity trial, then compare with PRE bypassed. EQ 33Hz +5→0 and 8kHz +5→+2; capture Bass 62→56. Recheck actual peak behavior rather than assuming two heavy compressors improve slap.
Keep CleanSVT, COMP and the CTL drive option. Bass OD Gain 35→25, Blend 40→30; Room Mix 10→5. This is a modest refinement rather than an amp redesign.
Keep CleanB15 and COMP4. Reduce CTL Room Mix 12→6 or leave it bypassed; use playing dynamics for the chorus. No added drive needed.

Capture Gain 60→50 and Treble 65→56; Gate THRE 25→12; EQ 4.5kHz +6→+2. Micro Boost Gain 45→25 and Room Mix 20→6. The bright clean target is currently pushed at several consecutive stages. Correct the album attribution in the write-up after checking the release.
Capture Bass 65→56, EQ 50Hz +3→+1; Hall Mix 30→8 and Decay 45→30. Gate THRE 20→10 for fretless decay. Keep FullB15 and passive Sire; the soulful lift should retain a clear front edge.
Micro Boost Gain 55→25, Room Mix 20→6 and EQ 2kHz +5→+3. Keep GrittySVT and one board compressor. Let the guitars carry the broad chorus space.

Remove the always-on Bass OD Gain 63/Blend 75. Keep GrittySVT, Micro Boost Gain 58→25, Room Mix 22→6. Compare the verse at matched level before adding any dirt back; its current permanent saturation conflicts with the restrained-verse description.
Keep the dry CleanSVT foundation. Bass OD Blend 50→30, Gain 30→20; CTL EQ 800Hz +6→+3 and 4.5kHz +4→+2. Preserve fast-note separation rather than making the unison passages aggressively nasal.

Gate THRE 30→12; capture Gain 60→50, Treble 65→56. Room Mix 20→6. Keep Micro Boost initially at 35 and compare its on-state against the clean target; this chain is already bright without the extra capture gain.
Remove the optional Bass OD for the clean dancehall target. Either leave one consistent tone or repurpose CTL to a small EQ output lift. Keep CleanB15, COMP4 and the existing modest EQ.
Remove Bass OD and reduce Plate Mix 18→6. Capture Bass 62→56 and EQ 50Hz +3→+1. Keep the warm FullB15 pulse; the dual-guitar outro does not itself require distorted or wetter bass.

Rebuild around one fuzz source rather than every drive available: keep Stylish Fuzz, turn Tidal Wave drive off and remove GP-5 Bass OD; start capture Gain 58→50. Remove CTL Room and reduce Micro Boost Gain 55→25. Compare Flamma off/on and retain only a quiet octave blend if the riff remains intelligible. HairySVT already adds dirt; if it obscures the riff, trial CleanSVT slot 53 at audited VOL 65 behind the fuzz.
Hall Mix 33→8 and Decay 58→35; Micro Boost Gain 48→25; EQ 33Hz +4→0. Keep Avalon and optional subtle chorus. A large choir can carry the spaciousness while the bass remains centered and defined.
Keep the dark CleanB15/COMP voice. Room Mix 16→6; capture Bass 60→56 only if the low strings boom. No drive or forced extra state.
Keep the clean ballad core. Plate Mix 18→7 and Decay 42→30. Preserve the current EQ; its small upper-mid lift helps long notes speak without adding dirt.
Remove CTL Bass OD and use Room Mix 12→6 as an optional space change, or choose an EQ/output lift. COMP4 Sustain 50→40. Preserve the clean Avalon voice for the polished ballad.

Remove fixed Bass OD Gain 72/Blend 78 and keep HairySVT plus a restrained Tidal Wave drive if needed. Micro Boost Gain 60→25; Room Mix 20→0/bypassed; Gate THRE 40→20. Capture Middle 68→58 and EQ 2kHz +8→+3. Keep aggression without the severe gate and repeated mid/drive stacking.

Bass OD Gain 40→25, Blend 50→30; COMP Sustain 50→40; Gate THRE 22→12. Keep ProgSVT and the dry routing. Confirm the actual section contrast rather than relying on a general Riverside-metal description.
Gate THRE 35→12; capture Gain 60→50 and Bass 62→56; Micro Boost Gain 55→25. Room Mix 22→6, Decay 40→25. This is a clean country bass role with unnecessarily firm gating and a heavily boosted input.
Keep CleanSVT and the dry clean/dirty split. Bass OD Gain 40→25, Blend 38→30 as a first comparison. Retain the stronger setting only if the bass itself needs that edge in the arrangement.
Gate THRE 22→10; Room Mix 28→8 and Decay 40→25. Keep Avalon and the light B-Chorus, but compare MOD bypassed for the main groove. Avoid treating glossy production as proof of chorused bass.

Remove permanent Bass OD and keep GrittySVT as the rhythm voice. Use CTL Bass OD Gain 25/Blend 30 instead of Micro Boost Gain 55 if extra chorus grit is needed; remove Room or lower Mix 14→5. This makes the gain change explicit and reduces serial saturation.

B-Chorus VOL 100→50 as a level-match starting point; Gate THRE 25→10; Room Mix 30→8 and Decay 45→25. Compare chorus bypassed before committing to it. Keep passive Sire/CleanB15 and a relaxed, present note attack.

Remove fixed Bass OD Gain 65/Blend 75, retain BrightSVT, and reduce Micro Boost Gain 55→25. Hall Mix 28→6. The fast gallop needs articulation; more distortion and large reverb are poor substitutes for a bigger arrangement.
Keep Avalon and single compression. B-Chorus Depth 25→15; Room Mix 20→6; Micro Boost Gain 42→25. Remove the stale J-120 reference in the compressor explanation, since the patch now uses Avalon.

Remove CTL Bass OD Gain 55/Blend 65. Keep GrittySVT with a lighter Tidal Wave Drive 40→25/Blend 60→35, or use that board drive only for the solo/outro. Capture Bass 60→55 and EQ 33Hz +4→0. Let the shuffle retain note edges.
Gate THRE 20→8, Hall Mix 25→7 and Decay 45→30. Keep Avalon; compare continuous chorus off. Bring EQ 400Hz -3→0 if the flatwound line loses body beneath strings.

Remove CTL Darktale Gain 65 and Micro Boost. Use the Tidal Wave drive stomp for the climax at trial Drive 25/Blend 35; Room Mix 20→6 in the restrained state. A non-blended guitar distortion ahead of the bass capture risks stripping note body. Keep CleanSVT.

Remove CTL Bass OD: the write-up explicitly specifies clean throughout. Boost Gain 60→20 with +3dB off, or remove it. Capture Gain 58→50 and Bass 62→55; EQ 50Hz +4→+1, 400Hz -5→-2, 800Hz +6→+2, 4.5kHz +6→+2. Keep the dance pocket rather than a scooped, overdriven chorus.
Gate THRE 25→12; Room Mix 22→6. Keep Avalon and the mild Micro Boost, but compare Gain 35→20 if CTL adds grit rather than clean presence. The clean uptempo role does not need an ambient second state.

Remove CTL Bass OD and Room; one dry tone suits the riff. Capture Bass 65→55, Middle 45→50; EQ 50Hz +4→0, 120Hz +3→+1, 800Hz -3→0. The existing dark high end is sufficient; repeated bass boosts and mid cuts risk hiding the defining line.
Gate THRE 30→8 for passive fretless. Room Mix 25→6; capture Gain 56→50. Keep the warm CleanB15 and mild CTL lift. Let note muting create the short country envelope rather than gating the decay.
Room Mix 24→6; EQ 400Hz -4→-1, 800Hz -2→+1 and 4.5kHz +5→+2. Gate THRE 28→15. Keep GrittySVT and the modest boost, restoring low-mid definition instead of scooping it while boosting edge.

Keep HairySVT, but trial Bass OD bypassed; if the riff loses needed edge, restore at Gain 25/Blend 30. CTL EQ VOL 56→52 and 800Hz +3 unchanged initially. Avoid making the chorus simply much louder and more compressed.
Keep FullB15, compression and the dry EQ. Remove optional CTL Bass OD unless the actual bass part needs grit; this is otherwise a well restrained roots-rock voice. No replacement effects needed.

Explicitly add EQ VOL 50. It is absent from the JSON and therefore encoded as 0 in an active EQ block; hardware attenuation must be checked, but the missing output value is a definite configuration defect. Then audition Mess Bass + User IR 7 for consistency with the other Myung patches: Gain 40/VOL 62/Bass 54/Middle 58/Treble 52, CAB VOL 58. Remove fixed Bass OD first; if needed use Gain 25/Blend 30. Room Mix 35→6; EQ 400Hz -6→-2, 800Hz +8→+3, 4.5kHz +10→+3. This deserves the first rebuild trial.
Micro Boost Gain 50→25, Room Mix 20→6. Keep Avalon and compare B-Chorus Depth 20→12 or bypassed. The clean pulse should stay closer to the drummer than the guitar's processed space.
Keep the warm CleanB15/COMP foundation. Remove Bass OD as a default chorus requirement; retain it only as an explicitly optional cover-arrangement color. Existing EQ is restrained.
Keep the current dry, articulate FullB15/COMP4 setup. Room Mix 10→5 or bypassed for the chorus. No amp or gain redesign needed.
Keep CleanB15 and the dark, simple pocket. Room Mix 15→6. If rolling the bass tone down plus capture Treble 38 plus EQ 4.5kHz -4 obscures pitch, lift capture Treble to 44 before adding output level.

EQ VOL 100→50 as the first level-match trial; Gate THRE 25→8. EQ 50Hz +5→+1 and 120Hz +3→+1; Room Mix 25→6. Keep passive Sire/CleanB15. The EQ level is an unexplained outlier, and the upright-like target needs body without excessive sub weight.

Remove CTL La Charger Gain 60 and Micro Boost Gain 52. Use the Tidal Wave drive stomp as the added grit at Drive 25/Blend 35; Hall Mix 30→8. Keep CleanSVT. Add subtle B-Chorus only as an optional listening comparison if the Duff-style texture needs width; do not add it just from the artist's general reputation.

Remove SM Dist Gain 70 and the simultaneous Micro Boost. Use board Tidal Wave drive for the heavy sections at its existing Drive 30, reducing Blend 55→35 for the trial. Room Mix 20→5 in the intro. Keep GrittySVT provisionally, but compare CleanSVT if the intro never cleans up. No serial guitar-distortion wall on a fast bass line.

Bass OD Gain 50→30, Blend 55→35; Room Mix 14→6. Keep CleanSVT and the clean verse. Correct the Weathered-era bassist attribution: verify the album credits rather than assigning the part to Brian Marshall.
Keep CleanSVT and the modest CTL Bass OD option. Trial Gain 28→18, Blend 30→25 and Room Mix 12→6. Keep the anthem weight through note length and attack.

Keep the dry CleanB15 thump and pickup instructions. Reduce capture Bass 62→56 and EQ 120Hz +3→+1 only if the repeated figure booms. Remove the automatic Micro Boost lift if it changes the pocket; one tone is legitimate here. Verify the credited bassist before retaining the Bob Babbitt assertion.

Correct the premise before tonal revision: Parallels is on Going for the One (1977), and the official credits distinguish Wakeman's church organ from Squire's bass. Remove the unsupported church-organ-amplified-bass claim. Bypass V-Roto Depth 55, remove Bass OD Gain 75 and use BrightSVT with a restrained board drive. Capture Gain 60→50/Middle 70→58; Gate 35→18; Hall Mix 20→6; EQ 2kHz +8→+3. The present processing is built around a mistaken instrument attribution.

Keep WorshipSVT and COMP4. Bass OD Gain 32→20, Blend 35→25; COMP4 Sustain 50→40 if the groove feels flat. Keep the dry architecture. Confirm any specific section cues against the version being played.

Room Mix 20→6 in the slow intro; Micro Boost Gain 50→25. Keep the inverted reverb transition into the fast section. The tempo/feel change itself supplies the energy, so avoid a large gain jump on top.
Keep the upright approximation, compression and mid body. Room Mix 12→5 and Gate THRE 18→8. Let palm muting shape short notes; avoid using the gate as an envelope control.

Keep Mess Bass/User IR 7. Bass OD Gain 55→25, Blend 70→35; Room Mix 22→5; AMP Bass 62→55 and EQ 800Hz -2→+1. The current heavy state obscures the precise Myung role with drive and a scooped low-mid voice.

Keep the clean SVT core; Hall Mix 35→8, Decay 55→35, Micro Boost Gain 48→25. Remove the unsupported claim of little/no bass guitar on the title track and verify track-specific credits before describing this as a newly invented bass part. The official album credits list BrownMark on bass, which is enough to flag the write-up for correction but not establish every note of the title-track mix.
Keep the gentle upright-like CleanB15 voice. Hall Mix 14→5 and Decay 40→25. No dirt or additional CTL function needed.
Keep CleanB15 and compression. Bass OD Gain 24→15, Blend 28→20; Room Mix 12→6. Treat the grit as optional, since the current tonal description only calls for a warm chorus swell.

Keep the shared board settings and Avalon. Compare COMP4 bypassed against Sustain 42→30; the Donner already compresses the source. Preserve whichever retains the handclap groove's attack. No forced CTL.

Capture Bass 60→55; Bass OD Gain 35→20, Blend 45→30; Hall Mix 18→8 and Trail off→on for smooth sustained transitions. Keep ProgSVT provisionally and verify the specific recording rather than the band's general rig.
Keep the upright-like CleanB15 and single board compressor. Hall Mix 14→6, Decay 40→25. Leave BPM explicitly unverified in the write-up; the encoder's 120 default is not a measured song tempo.
Keep the CleanB15 pulse. Remove CTL Bass OD as the default clean-country lift; Room Mix 10→5. If a second sound is useful, use a mild EQ level lift instead of adding dirt and ambience together.

Keep the dry upright-style baseline and clearly labeled rock-cover option. Room Mix 10→5; CTL Bass OD Gain 35→25, Blend 35→25. The contrasting sound is valid because it is explicitly an adaptation rather than a claim about the original.
Keep BrightSVT, COMP4 and the dry hard-rock structure. Trial Bass OD Gain 40→25, Blend 40→30. No broader redesign needed.

Keep the one-compressor, board-drive architecture. BrightSVT plus Tidal Wave may already supply enough hook grit; compare Drive 35→25/Blend 30 unchanged. Room Mix 5 is appropriate. No extra GP-5 CTL for its own sake.

Hall Mix 45→10 and Decay 65→35; Gate THRE 25→8 for fretless. Keep Mess Bass/User IR 4, but EQ 400Hz -3→0 and 800Hz -1→+1 to retain pitch through the climax. Keep B-Chorus subtle and audition it bypassed before committing.

Choose one CTL push: keep Bass OD at Gain 20/Blend 25 and remove Micro Boost Gain 45. Room Mix 12→5; capture Bass 60→55. Keep Avalon provisionally and let the performance's accelerating build supply the scale.

Remove the simultaneous Micro Boost + Bass OD chorus stack. Use board Tidal Wave drive for the heavy adaptation if needed, or Bass OD alone at Gain 25/Blend 30. Hall Mix 25→8. Keep CleanSVT and the write-up's distinction between a cover arrangement and the actual recorded part.

Remove CTL Bass OD initially; Deepsea Mix 25→12, Trail off→on. Capture Bass 62→56 and EQ 800Hz -3→0. Keep the dark FullB15 atmosphere, but retain a discernible note center beneath the low ambient tail.

Trial Mess Bass + User IR 7 against ProgSVT using the same starting values proposed for Metropolis, with a separate level match. Remove simultaneous Micro Boost; Bass OD Gain 45→25/Blend 60→35 and Room Mix 22→5. Gate THRE 30→18 if soft fast notes drop out. Use the direct modeled amp as a candidate, without claiming it proves the exact Train of Thought rig.
Keep FullB15 and the modest EQ. Micro Boost Gain 50→25; Room Mix 15→5. Consider a light COMP in PRE instead of a chorus boost if the moving line needs control; match output before deciding.
Keep CleanB15, the mid-forward curve and the single board compressor. Compare CTL Micro Boost Gain 30→20 for a restrained lift. The basic boogie voice does not need extra ambience.
Keep GrittySVT and dry Duff-style pick attack. Bass OD Gain 38→25, Blend 42→30; COMP4 Sustain 50→40 if the repeated line loses bounce. No mandatory chorus addition.

Keep HairySVT, but remove the fixed Bass OD first. If more saturation is needed, restore at Gain 25/Blend 30; reduce Micro Boost Gain 40→25. Capture Bass 60→55. Clarify that standard 5-string fingering must produce the recording's actual C# pitches; 'off the low B' is not a complete transposition instruction.
Keep passive Sire/CleanB15. EQ 33Hz +4→0, 8kHz +4→0; Room Mix 18→6, Micro Boost Gain 45→25 and capture Bass 62→56. The current low-sub and high-air boosts work against the intended warm soul pocket.
Gate THRE 20→8; Room Mix 20→6; EQ 33Hz +3→0, 150Hz +4→+2, 2kHz -3→0. Keep passive Sire/CleanB15 and a small CTL push only if it helps the arrangement.

Keep the orchestral-bass adaptation and board drive for ensemble shouts. Hall Mix 10→5 and Tidal Wave Drive 40→25 as a first comparison; preserve the staccato articulation. Leave tempo unverified rather than promoting the encoder default to a song fact.

Remove GP-5 COMP4 while retaining the shared Donner. Capture Gain 60→50; Bass OD Gain 55→25/Blend 50→30; EQ 50Hz +4→+1, 800Hz +5→+2 and 4.5kHz +5→+2. Keep the shared board unchanged while reducing serial compression and drive inside this patch.
Keep Avalon and the restrained CTL chorus/Plate concept. Plate Mix 12→6; COMP4 Sustain 50→40 if pops and sustained notes flatten excessively. Existing modulation depth is reasonable.

Remove permanent Bass OD Gain 62/Blend 75 and audition HairySVT alone. Micro Boost Gain 55→25, fixed Room Mix 18→5, EQ 33Hz +4→0 and capture Bass 60→55. Preserve the dark character without smearing the groove beneath the acoustic guitar.
Hall Mix 32→8 and Decay 50→35; Micro Boost Gain 50→25; EQ 50Hz +3→+1. Keep CleanSVT and the single board compressor. The choir supplies the outro's space; the melodic bass should stay present.

Remove GP-5 Bass OD first and reduce Boost Gain 55→25/+3dB off while keeping the shared Tidal Wave settings. Capture Gain 60→50; EQ 50Hz +6→+1 and 4.5kHz +6→+2. This trims the repeated low/treble boosts and drive layers without changing the set's board foundation.

Keep the synth-bass adaptation, but audition without the permanent O-Phase. Toucher Mix 70→45; remove added Bass OD first and use the board fuzz as the principal synth distortion. Room Mix 22→0/bypassed and EQ 50Hz +4→+1. Check filter tracking with the board compressor: a heavily flattened envelope can make Sense adjustments misleading.

Keep passive Sire, FullB15 and the dry muted pocket. Room Mix 10→5. Correct the blanket assertion that active mode inherently adds headroom or hi-fi tone; here passive is a musical choice, not an electrical guarantee.
Remove CTL Bass OD initially; Plate Mix 14→7 with Trail on for sustained transitions. Capture Bass 60→55 and EQ 800Hz -2→0. Keep the light chorus, provided it remains underneath the melody.
Keep Avalon and the clean 70s pocket. Remove optional Bass OD unless the cover arrangement specifically benefits from grit. The current modest EQ and single COMP already serve the described job.
Keep CleanSVT and the clean/heavy split. Bass OD Gain 30→20, Blend 35→25; Room Mix 12→6. Let the chorus gain weight without moving the bass behind the band.

Remove permanent GP-5 Bass OD and keep BrightSVT plus a lighter Tidal Wave Drive 25/Blend 35. Micro Boost Gain 45→25 and Room Mix 16→5. This retains pick punch while reducing the three serial dirt sources.
Keep WorshipSVT. Capture Bass 62→56, Middle 45→50; Bass OD Gain 30→20/Blend 30→25; Hall Mix 12→6. Sustain the roots without a scooped, sub-heavy voice underneath keys.
Keep Avalon and the one-compressor roots-rock layout. Micro Boost Gain 42→25; Room Mix 15→5. No need to rebuild the basic voice.
